versions.subject: New Rules: transformed elastic to sigma rules
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - 'DumpCreds'
        - 'DumpCerts'
selection_2:
    ScriptBlockText|contains: 'sekurlsa::logonpasswords'
selection_3:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - 'crypto::certificates'
        - 'CERT_SYSTEM_STORE_LOCAL_MACHINE'
condition: 1 of selection*
